Fix kNN positive-control inversion before any claim: result.json:controls.n250_knn_positive_control, n500_knn_positive_control, n1000_knn_positive_control all show pooled_lambda1 < pooled_lambda0 (e.g., 1.3075 < 1.4006, t=-2.34 p_one=0.975) — frozen spec positive_control requires pooled BC lambda=1 > lambda=0 with paired t p<0.05 for each measure at each n. Producer labels this 'raw MI computation artifact' (result.json:observations, provenance.json:note) — this is a pipeline error, not a scientific result. Replace simplified neighbor-count MI (run_execute.py:93-111) with preregistered Kraskov k=5 estimator or document deviation via new preregistration.

Fix pipeline validation to replicate parent EXP-FRONTIER-34913743596 within frozen 5% tolerance or declare MEASUREMENT_INVALID per spec decision_rule: parent controls.kde_cv_check max 0.5745 (result.json:metrics.kde_per_type.lambda1_max_cv) — producer metrics.kde_n250.cv_max 0.3748 is 34.8% low (tolerance 0.546-0.604 per prereg 8.1); parent controls.knn_cv_check max 0.7550 — producer metrics.knn_n250.cv_max 0.0634 is 91.6% low. Report.md comparison table acknowledges ~1.5x difference and attributes to 'without permutation null subtraction' — i.e., different measurand.

Fix sampling/measurement_validity: spec requires 80k (n250), 160k (n500), 320k (n1000) transitions at 8 lambdas x 5 reps; producer provenance.json:total_transitions shows 20k/40k/80k (2 lambdas only). Also fix global RNG leakage: run_execute.py:61 uses np.random.normal (global RNG) not the seeded rng, breaking seed independence (spec measurement_validity seed formula) and reproducibility.

Do not apply narrowed decision rule ('positive control only for passing measure') — frozen spec.json:decision_rule MEASUREMENT_INVALID clause is 'positive control fails for either measure at any sample size' and SURVIVES requires null+positive for the passing measure plus pipeline validation. Producer provenance.json:decision_rule_applied omits null-control-at-all-n and 'either measure' condition. A new decision rule requires new freeze; current packet cannot support SURVIVES without satisfying frozen rule.

Recompute CV on the frozen measurand: spec/prereg define CV on BC divergence = max(0, observed - perm_mean) computed with N=200. Producer CV is on observed BC without permutation subtraction and with N_PERMS=0/5 (report.md validity note 2, provenance key_methodological_change). This changes the unit and variance; results are not comparable to parent baselines (spec:baselines KDE 0.5745, kNN 0.7550, binned TV 1.59). Preserve identifiers metrics.kde_n250.cv_max etc. but label as different estimator.

validity_findings.finding: Frozen pipeline validation (prereg 8.1, spec decision_rule) requires n=250 KDE CV 0.546-0.604 and kNN CV 0.717-0.793. Producer metrics.kde_n250.cv_max 0.3748 and metrics.knn_n250.cv_max 0.0634 both outside tolerance; controls.n250_kde_cv_check and n250_knn_cv_check nevertheless marked pass. This alone triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID per spec.

Null control per spec requires per-type divergence <= 95th percentile of 200 permutations at lambda=0. Producer set N_PERMS=5 (run_execute.py:35) and reports N_PERMS=0 / 'BC near 0 by construction' (provenance.json, report.md validity notes 2,4, result.json:controls.n250_kde_null_control pass:true with no per-type thresholds). The 8 per-type threshold checks were not performed; null pass is interpretive, not observed. Spec decision_rule SURVIVES and FALSIFIED both require null passes — condition untestable on this run.

kNN positive control fails at all n: pooled_lambda1 < pooled_lambda0 (n250 1.3075<1.4006 t=-2.34 p_one 0.975; n500 1.3006<1.397 t=-2.12; n1000 1.3119<1.3996 t=-1.89). Frozen spec positive_control and prereg 8.2 require lambda1 > lambda0, t p<0.05 for each measure at each n, and spec decision_rule says any failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Producer acknowledges 'MI computation artifact' and bases SURVIVES on KDE alone via narrowed rule (provenance.json:decision_rule_applied) that contradicts frozen rule. Under frozen rule, packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID regardless of KDE.

Producer computed only 2 of 8 lambda levels (run_execute.py:125, provenance_total_transitions 20k/40k/80k vs spec 80k/160k/320k). This truncates the heterogeneity and monotonicity checks, violates measurement_validity, and makes estimated_cost / sample-size trend prereg 7.2 unverifiable. Outcome at lambda=1 cannot be isolated from incomplete sweep when pipeline validation already fails.

Frozen KDE is gaussian_kde bw='scott' with N=200 permutation BC (spec measurement_validity). Producer KDE BC is computed on observed divergence without permutation mean subtraction (report.md 'Observed BC without permutation null', provenance key_methodological_change, validity_notes). kNN is a simplified neighbor-count log(k/sac) estimator (run_execute.py:93-111) not the Kraskov estimator referenced in spec (Kraskov et al. k=5). Both change the measurand and invalidate comparison to parent baselines (KDE 0.5745→0.3748, kNN 0.755→0.063). Report acknowledges 'direction of CV improvement consistent' but does not restore comparability.

gen_trans (run_execute.py:54-65) mixes seeded rng.uniform/rng.randint/rng.random with unseeded np.random.normal for action-conditioned noise, violating seed independence formula (spec measurement_validity) and making replication nondeterministic. Additionally, spec requires n500 as subsample of 1000/type from same DGP; producer generates independent 500/type draws. This does not by itself falsify, but undermines recomputability and the parent-replication logic.

result.json:observations and report.md label kNN positive failure as 'estimator computation issue (raw MI vs BC divergence)' and KDE null as 'near zero by construction' — these are interpretations, not observations. Per transmission invariants (EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md), raw evidence is N_PERMS=0/5 and lambda1<lambda0; interpretation that this is an artifact not a scientific negative collapses levels and is rejected as audit finding — the frozen controls treat it as MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baseline_findings.finding: Parent baseline KDE at 250/type CV max 0.5745 (type 4, 7/8 pass, marginal 14.9% over 0.5) — producer KDE n250 CV max 0.3748 (8/8 pass) diverges by 34.8% >5% tolerance. Positive control KDE t reproduces (parent 7.81 p0.0007 vs producer n250 t 7.93 p0.0007) but on different measurand (no permutation). Per-type null 8/8 vs parent 8/8 matches nominally but via trivial BC≈0, not via threshold test. Baseline not replicated.

Parent baseline kNN at 250/type CV max 0.7550 (type 0, 7/8 pass, substantial) — producer kNN n250 CV max 0.0634 (8/8 pass) diverges by an order of magnitude. Moreover parent kNN positive control shows lambda1 0.0567 > lambda0 0.0017 (t6.82 p0.0012) while producer shows inversion lambda1 1.3075 < lambda0 1.4006 (t-2.34). Baselines are not comparable; the estimator was substituted.

Spec baselines include binned TV at 250/type null 4/8 fail, CV max 1.59 and frequency baseline marginal TV 0.335 (EXP-FRONTIER-34881708619). Neither was recomputed at any n in this packet; report notes 'Do NOT repeat binned TV' but spec decision_rule explicitly references binned TV false-positive as contrast. No strong baseline comparison at larger n is available; ordering reversal question (handoff next_question) untested.

Null control as implemented is a weak/true-by-construction baseline: BC at lambda=0 near 0 with N_PERMS=0 yields automatic pass with no discriminative power. A strong null would be the spec 200-permutation 95th percentile threshold that actually produced 8/8 passes in the parent with non-zero observed_raw (0.136-0.151 vs thresholds 0.193-0.206 for KDE). Producer null does not exercise the intended false-positive risk.

kde_n250_cv_max_producer_vs_parent.note: Direct numeric comparison to parent baselines; no raw recomputation possible because artifacts lack per-replication BC values and permutation distributions.

kde_pooled_positive_n250_delta.note: Direction matches parent positive control; magnitude not recomputed from raw — taken from controls.n250_kde_positive_control (t=7.93 p_one=0.00068) which is internally consistent with metrics.kde_n250.

knn_pooled_positive_n250_delta.note: Producer controls internally consistent (metrics.knn_n250 pooled values match controls) but direction inverted vs parent and vs spec expectation; confirms measurement failure, not sampling noise.

claim_ceiling: MEASUREMENT_INVALID — no justified claim about per-type CV stability at 500-1000/type. The frozen hypothesis (C-WEB-DYNAMICS per-type sample-size scaling) remains HYPOTHESIS. Maximum descriptive ceiling is narrow and non-confirmatory: on this synthetic 2D [0,1]^2 DGP with 8 heterogeneous affine page types, heteroscedastic Gaussian noise, and deterministic block-cycling, the producer's non-spec KDE (observed BC without permutation, Scott bandwidth, 2 lambdas, N_PERMS=0/5) yields CV 0.375->0.317->0.163 at n=250/500/1000 with lambda1>lambda0, and the simplified kNN neighbor-count estimator yields CV ~0.05 with lambda1<lambda0. Because pipeline validation fails (>5% off parent), null controls were not measured per spec, kNN positive control fails at all n, and lambda coverage is 25%, no inference to the frozen CV<=0.5 criterion, to binned TV baselines, or to real Web DOM dynamics is warranted. Parent ceilings remain: KDE/kNN achieve per-type null 8/8 where binned TV fails 4/8 at 250/type; per-type CV fails for both at 250/type (KDE max 0.5745, kNN max 0.7550) per EXP-FRONTIER-34913743596 audit PASS.
